name: E2E: Knowledge article insufficient leads to incident creation
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a user asks a question, receives a knowledge article that doesn't resolve the issue, and the assistant seamlessly transitions to ticket creation with conversation history preserved.
precondition: User has valid credentials. Knowledge articles exist but may not fully resolve the specific issue.

steps.description: Log in to the self-service portal and navigate to home page
steps.expectedResult: Home page loads with Agentforce icon visible

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon to open the AI Assistant
Ask a question that returns a knowledge article
steps.testData: "How do I fix the printer error on the 3rd floor"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant retrieves a relevant knowledge article about printer troubleshooting

steps.description: Indicate the article did not resolve the issue
steps.expectedResult: The assistant offers to create a ticket

steps.description: Confirm desire to create a ticket
steps.expectedResult: The assistant begins gathering additional details

steps.description: Provide remaining required details as prompted
steps.testData: Location, urgency, additional context as requested
steps.expectedResult: The assistant gathers all information and presents summary
Incident is created with conversation history as context

steps.description: Verify incident number and link are displayed
steps.expectedResult: Incident number (INC-XXXXX) and link are shown

steps.description: Verify the knowledge article interaction is recorded in ticket history
steps.expectedResult: Ticket description or history references the knowledge article that was tried
